description: This file defines a React functional component 'MenuItemCard' used to display individual menu items in a food delivery web application. It includes an interface for menu item props, state management for quantity, and a UI for displaying item details with an 'Add' button.

methods.name: MenuItemCard
methods.description: React component for displaying a menu item with quantity selection and add button.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Function invoked when user clicks 'Add' button; currently a stub that shows an alert.
